## Product notes
- The primary positioning is: free online tools for work, study and everyday practical tasks.
- Public discovery is organized by user goal, audience segment, model, guide and tool category.
- Public pages explain each tool before registration.
- Some editors require a free account to save and export documents.
- Premium access is optional and does not change the public educational content.
- Legal, labor and accounting materials are educational and do not replace professional advice.
- Jato Games is a separate content vertical under the same domain; it does not replace Precisou, Tá Pronto document tools.
- Native diagnostics process hardware data locally and require explicit consent; no report is uploaded automatically.

## Editorial and trust notes
- Content pages state scope, limitations and the related action whenever applicable.
- Legal, labor, accounting and hardware comparisons are educational estimates and avoid guarantees about individual outcomes.
- Game requirements are maintained as a versioned editorial catalog with source and review information.
- The public library connects intent-based answers, FAQs, guides and the corresponding tool.
- Organization, WebSite, CollectionPage, ItemList, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage and SoftwareApplication structured data are used where semantically appropriate.
